# LUXERIS

> Mumbai-based corporate gifting company with 22+ years of experience. We supply customised executive gift sets, Diwali hampers, trophies, calendars, and branded merchandise for businesses across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane and pan-India.

LUXERIS (luxerisgifting.in) is a Mumbai-based corporate gifting company offering customised gifting solutions for businesses. We work with HR, procurement, sales and event teams who need professional gifts that arrive on time and still feel considered — not catalogue leftovers.

We handle the complete process: product selection, custom branding (logo printing, engraving, embroidery), packaging, and coordinated dispatch. Every order is quoted after a short brief. No online cart, no hidden pricing.

**Key facts**
- Experience: 22+ years in the gifting trade
- Location: 3rd Bhoiwada Road, Bhuleshwar, Mumbai – 400002
- Service area: Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane + pan-India delivery
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 98208 10040 | luxerisgifting@gmail.com
- Typical response: Same business day on WhatsApp
